about: The verification record behind src/data/teammatesPairs.ts (Teammates or Not), Round 921, read 2026-10-02.
players: every named player's team by season, read from two hosts. Seasons are the ones the host credits the player with games for that team, so a season spent injured all year is absent.
rows: each shipped row, word for word. scripts/simTeammatesRecord.mjs derives the answer from the two hosts and fails if the row disagrees, then checks every claim and every year in the funFact.
adjudications: the few pairs the season tables cannot settle (both men split a season between teams, or a soccer pair with no season table here), each fact on two hosts.
legacy rows: 15 soccer rows kept from before this round, not verified by this record. They are owed a verification round.

hostsTried.result: HTTP 406 to the fetch tool; its own data API statsapi.mlb.com answers and is used instead
no answer (timeout); www.nba.com player pages carry no career table, so NBA rows use basketball-reference and ESPN, with nba.com used for the trade adjudication
career pages for Russell Wilson and DeAndre Hopkins carry no stats table; cbssports.com is used for those two
